notes.title: Bug Fix, Balancing and Cheat mode for children
notes.content:
- Balancing for high level monsters
- Fix small bugs during combat
- Added Children mode with a cheat that gives you infinite gold and you can't die (not suggested for normal players 6+). Press 106 at the start menu to activate!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
- Strange behavior with Cleric ability fixed
- Cost of special abilities rest between two consecutive runs
- Video optimization

notes.title: Game Released!
notes.content:
After some review from players and suggestion i think the game is ready for the actual release. 
As some of you know form other games i'm a solo Italian developer and i code for fun, i really enjoyed to make this and i hope you find it funny and interesting. 

I'm always open to feedbacks!

Roberto
